items.title: Court rejects Nevada ranchers' demand to swiftly remove excess wild horses
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: On October 29, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit upheld a decision favoring federal officials regarding wild horses. Ranchers Colvin & Son, LLC and Stone Cabin Ranch challenged the Bureau of Land Management's Gather Plans for lacking a specific timetable.
